prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Create ONE polished environment concept image of an ISOLATED REHEARSAL NOOK CUTAWAY DIORAMA, suitable as a clear single-image reference for generating a 3D model.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the approved rehearsal nook: preserve its identity, warm palette, piano, seating, arched window and rich purposeful set dressing. Image 2 is only a spatial presentation reference: use the self-contained corner-on-a-base format of those dioramas, not their objects or colors. Image 3 is ONLY the expressive hand-drawn linework reference; ignore its character and UI completely.

SPATIAL REBUILD: Show the ENTIRE corner module in a slightly elevated three-quarter orthographic-style view, looking into the open front of two perpendicular walls that form a clear 90-degree L. A single shallow square stone floor slab is seen as a diamond/trapezoid in perspective. Both front sides are fully open; no roof, no ceiling, no foreground wall. Clear exposed wall thickness and clean top and side cut edges. The entire silhouette, including slab edges and top of the window, fits within the canvas with generous clean white margin. Ground everything on the slab; no floating disconnected props, no room or scenery extending beyond the base. Coherent 3D scale, perspective, supports and contact shadows. Camera about 25–30 degrees above eye level, enough to reveal layout without looking top-down. Warm ivory-white empty background and a very faint ground shadow only.

LAYOUT AND COMPOSITION: Piano anchored against LEFT wall, broad attractive plain oak upright body, legible keyboard facing into the open space. Matching cushioned piano bench sits in front with convincing seated-player clearance. On the RIGHT wall, a tall broad arched window and deep built-in window seat form the taller visual anchor. Sage cushions and one simply draped plum throw; window opening entirely contained in the wall. Very pale blue glazing with a faint flat Alpine silhouette contained WITHIN the window opening, no outdoor terrain or extra building model. The two walls meet visibly behind the piano/window grouping. In the open middle/right foreground place ONE sturdy low stool and a wooden music stand with open score angled toward it. Neither blocks the keyboard, piano bench or window seat. Maintain open floor and access between piano and window seat. Cello on its stable floor stand tucked near the outer right wall edge beside a simple closed case; clear silhouette distinct from seat and stand. A lute hangs above the piano, small brass reading lamp and three grouped books atop piano. ONE leafy potted plant sits at the window-seat end, a short shelf carries grouped music books, and ONE basket with folded cloth and a small frame drum sits near the cello. Keep all details inside the footprint. A muted terracotta rug with only a broad border connects the seating and music stand. Grounded substantial objects, natural proportions, beautiful deliberately grouped set dressing. Balanced triangular composition between piano, tall window, and lower music stand/stool; readable gaps between major silhouettes and an inviting open front.

ART STYLE — IMPORTANT CHANGE: The drawing must be led by expressive SKETCHED PENCIL LINEWORK like Image 3. Dark plum/graphite contours with clearly VARIED LINE WEIGHTS: strong broken strokes on outer silhouettes, overlaps and contact points, finer searching construction lines and light tapered interior marks. Visible lively double strokes and selective directional hatching in shadows. Keep the human irregularity of a good exploratory character sketch, translated to architecture and objects. Apply CLEAN, QUIET, TRANSPARENT watercolor color fills UNDER the pencil. Broad smooth warm honey, muted sage, dusty plum and terracotta washes; a few deliberate soft value transitions and calm lavender shadows. Let generous areas of light paper show through. ELIMINATE the uniformly mottled distressed textures of Image 1: NO stippling, speckled highlights, paint chips, all-over scratches, crackle, grunge, noisy paper, busy fabric patterns, photographic wood grain or stone texture. Draw only a few useful wood seams and stone joints. Sketch line variation supplies texture; color fills stay calm and clean. Retain the rich set dressing and medium level of construction detail; do not reduce this to a bare blockout or childish toy.
One large attractive isolated corner, not a collage, no inset views, no labels, no dimensions, no characters, no logos, no UI. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Prioritize clean visible geometry and a pleasing, legible composition for 3D reference.
